release_notes: Intelligent Cohorts: Automated dynamic task cohorts (Urgent, Due Soon, In Progress, Upcoming, Overdue, Completed).
Task Analytics Dashboard: Visual completion rates, priority distribution, and velocity metrics.
Notes Report Export: 1-tap export of productivity summaries directly into rich MyDay Notes blocks.
Flexible Horizons: Daily, weekly, and monthly expense budgets with real-time spend tracking.
Threshold Warnings: Proactive alert flags at 80% and 100% budget utilization.
Custom Categories: Add unlimited custom categories with color palettes and custom icons.
Track Receivables & Payables: Monitor who owes you and who you owe with due date alerts.
Partial Repayments: Record partial or full repayments with quick-fill chips.
Ledger Balance Sync: Atomically update liquid Cash and Card account balances upon lending or repaying.
Immediate real-time data sync across Today Dashboard, Calendar, Finance, and Money Tracker without manual refresh.
